title: Time and Portraits

description.main: Portraits of artists and cultural figures by Shingo Wakagi, mostly from magazine work, published by Artbeat Publishers in 2007.
description.extended:
Time and Portraits is Shingo Wakagi's book of portraits of artists and other cultural figures, published in Tokyo by Artbeat Publishers in 2007.

Most of the portraits come from magazine assignments. A Japanese bookseller's description notes that with little time on a shoot, timing and circumstance end up shaping the picture more than coaxing out the sitter's best expression. Sitters include Lawrence Weiner, Wolfgang Tillmans, Kazuo Ohno, Hiroshi Sugimoto, Yoshitomo Nara, Ryuichi Sakamoto and Yohji Yamamoto. The bilingual Japanese and English hardcover was edited by Shigeo Goto, with art direction by Chie Morimoto and design by Chie Kai of goen°. It came with an obi and a separate pamphlet of Wakagi's conversation with Goto.

Wakagi's own site sorts his work into Portrait, Advertising, Commercial Movie, Magazine, Exhibition, Feature Film and Personal Work. The cover band names the photobook TAKUJI and the film Hoshikage no Waltz as his earlier work.
